title: closed-loop identity second dimension: directed pool set is independently checkable
policy: read-only: the SQLite store is opened with mode=ro, no repair runs, no broadcast is attempted and no historical depth or business data is backfilled. The pool ids are recomputed with the kernel's own derivation, so the check is on the same basis as the kernel check.

kernelDerivation.poolIdFormula: keccak256 of the 160-byte ABI encoding of the normalized V4 pool key (currency0, currency1, uint24 fee, int24 tickSpacing, hooks)
kernelDerivation.normalization: lowercase and trim only; never deduplicate, never reorder

publicationFreshness.note: a review that was produced before the Manager published its current set can only carry the older selection; a difference whose two sides straddle this boundary is a snapshot effect

reviewDifferenceAttribution.verdict: stale snapshot, not an identity defect: the reviews are older than the Manager publication and differ only in the third hop, where the publication selected the deeper pool

conclusion.verdict: every published loop carries an ordered pool set that the kernel's own derivation reproduces exactly
